## Summary

Cinder Lane Hardware Inc (policy CC-1592): power surge after a storm damaged a laptop and a phone at a conference venue in Bristol. The loss falls within clause 4.9, which requires the equipment to have been connected through a surge protector. The file does not say whether it was. The claim is provisionally accepted under clause 4.9, pending confirmation of that point. Reserve 6,598 dollars.

## Facts

Cinder Lane Hardware Inc reported the loss on 11 March 2026 [notice of loss]. The loss is described as a power surge after a storm [notice of loss], [incident report]. It occurred at a conference venue in Bristol [notice of loss], [incident report]. The items are a laptop and a phone [incident report], [invoice 1], [invoice 2]. The incident was recorded on 13 March 2026 under reference IR/2026/4208 [incident report]. No third party was involved [incident report]. No theft is alleged [notice of loss], [incident report]. The file does not state whether the laptop and phone were connected through a surge protector at the time [notice of loss], [incident report].

## Coverage analysis

The loss falls under clause 4.9 of the policy, which covers damage to electronic equipment caused by a surge in the electrical supply, where the equipment was connected through a surge protector [policy]. The cause and the type of equipment match the clause. The surge protector condition is not established by any document in the file [notice of loss], [incident report]. Clause 4.2 is not relied on, because the loss is recorded as caused by a power surge [notice of loss], [policy].

Exclusion 7.1 does not apply: no theft is alleged [policy], [notice of loss]. Exclusion 7.3 does not apply: the loss is recorded as a single surge event, not gradual deterioration [incident report], [policy]. Exclusion 7.5 does not apply: it operates only where theft is alleged, and none is [policy], [notice of loss].

## Decision

Covered under clause 4.9, on the condition that the equipment was connected through a surge protector. The file is silent on this, so the insured should be asked to confirm it before the acceptance is treated as final.

## Reserve

The reserve is 6,598 dollars, the sum of the two invoices (3,892 dollars and 2,706 dollars) [invoice 1], [invoice 2]. The policy extract in the file shows no schedule excess, so under clause 9.1 none applies [policy]. If the full schedule shows an excess, the reserve should be reduced accordingly.
